name: br-regional-payroll
description: Select the applicable regional wage floor for Brazilian private employment in calendar 2026 before computing payroll. Covers the occupation bands and effective dates in Paraná, Santa Catarina, São Paulo and Rio Grande do Sul, collective agreement precedence, remote-work territorial rules, Rio de Janeiro's conflicting historical tables and Supreme Court judgment, and eSocial salary-change evidence. Use for piso regional, salário mínimo estadual, state minimum wage, collective agreement wage floor, retroactive salary differences, CBO classification and multistate or remote employee payroll. Produces a dated salary-selection workpaper for the national payroll owner. It does not approve a particular collective agreement's validity or replace the full payroll calculation.
